title: 星痕绘梦 Starry Trace
description:
Welcome to Starry Trace!This is a relaxing yet thought-provoking puzzle game. With over 100 meticulously designed levels, the difficulty gradually increases, making it increasingly addictive as you play. Are you ready to embark on this starry painting journey?

Choose a star, leave your mark!
Tap the star you want to move, but remember: you can only switch stars after clearing all from the grid.

Fill the grid, complete the pattern!
Finish the target design within the allowed moves to win. Simple controls, but mastering it takes strategy!

More modes, endless challenges!

Random mode, shoot mode - each time it's a completely new challenge!

Game Features• Limited Moves: Plan carefully to solve puzzles in minimal steps.

• Progressive Unlocks: Beat a level to unlock the next—get ready for tougher challenges!

• Hint System: Stuck? Tap the lightbulb icon to view example solutions and help you progress smoothly.

• Random Mode: Enjoy fresh puzzles every time with infinite randomized stages.

• Shoot Mode: Rotate the grid and shoot stars to paint, matching the target pattern to clear the level.

• Speed Run: Stop the timer when you finish—race against the clock!

• Chill Soundtrack: Soothing BGM keeps you relaxed even during marathon sessions.

• Support for controllers: Connect a controller, kick back, and puzzle away with ease.

🎉 Start Your Celestial Adventure Now! 🎉Whether you’re sharpening your mind or unwinding, Starry Trace delivers endless fun. Who will become the ultimate "Starry Artist"?
description_short: Starry Trace is a relaxing, strategy‑driven puzzle game. Move stars to fill the grid and complete beautiful patterns. Challenge yourself with 100+ levels and endless randomized puzzles, accompanied by calming music and minimalist art. Ideal for casual and thoughtful players alike.
